## From a question to an answer you can use
:::

::: {.grid .grid-4 .steps}
::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 1]{.card-num}

### Define the question

We agree on what you need to decide, and what a good answer looks like.
:::

::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 2]{.card-num}

### Gather the data

Publications, patents, grants and trials, from open and trusted sources.
:::

::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 3]{.card-num}

### Screen and check

AI helps sort the records; people check the results against a hand-labelled sample.
:::

::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 4]{.card-num}

### Deliver clear answers

A short report, charts and, when useful, an interactive dashboard.
:::
:::
:::
:::

### Who studies ticks, and who leads the work?

A study of tick and tick-borne disease research worldwide, with a focus on Africa: who produces the research, who leads it, and who funds it.
